findings.F1: Inside the falling-calm profile, in folds B and C, the deeper the close sits below its 14-day high in 30-day-swing units, the worse the next 5 days. The two deepest fifths of depth (−9.2 to −2.9 swings) were followed by unusual moves of −3.7 % (t −2.47, 63 cases) and −3.9 % (t −3.3, 62 cases). The two shallowest fifths (−1.95 to 0) were followed by +1.3 % and +1.5 % (t 1.35 and 1.46). The forecast's slope t is 2.20 (340 cases, 125 days), against the verdict's 1.06 over all four folds.
findings.F2: The falling-calm depth effect in F1 sits almost entirely in the bear years. The deep half's unusual move against the shallow half's was −4.6 % vs +1.9 % in 2018 (79 and 88 cases) and −3.3 % vs −1.3 % in 2019. In 2020 and 2021 the deep half was positive (+1.7 % and +2.2 %) on only 9 and 13 cases. The deep half was negative on all six coins.
findings.F3: In a choppy market (60-day return within ±10 %), outside falling calm, the 14-day return scaled by the coin's 30-day swing continues over the next 5 days. Its slope t is 2.62 (125 cases, 65 days), and depth below the 14-day high gives t 2.33.
findings.F4: In the falling-agitated bars, the same two measures point the other way: ret14z slope t −0.89 and depth slope t −1.03 (150 cases, 44 days). This matches the falling-agitated rebound ideas the map already holds 12 of.
findings.F5: Over all bars, the top fifth of the 14-day swing-scaled return (above +3.3 swings) is followed by an unusual move of +2.2 % (t 2.85, 273 cases). The top fifth of nearness to the 14-day high outside falling calm gives +2.9 % (t 3.02, 211 cases). This rising-side continuation is what the held "nearness to high" and "rising breakout" ideas already capture, so it is not new.
findings.F6: The book's gain is small against holding the coins. It earned +0.15 % and +0.23 % a day in the two falling windows w7 and w14, where the coins fell 0.44 % and 0.43 % a day. It lost 0.05 % to 0.07 % a day in w16 to w18, where the coins rose. Its mean daily return was below the coin's on every coin: for BTC −0.014 % vs +0.159 %, for XRP −0.021 % vs +0.248 %.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 14-day return measured in units of its own 30-day daily swing, the further the coin moves the same way over the next 5 days, up after a rise and down after a fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a sideways coin would lean with its two-week swing-scaled move for the next five days, long after strong rises and short after strong falls, rather than fading it.
ideas.name: choppy market swing momentum
